scope: CAAT published registration guidance. Current temporary flight restrictions are not assessed here.

registrationRequired.note: Complete drone registration through CAAT's UAS Portal; check separate NBTC radio requirements.

pilotCertRequired.note: The CAAT guide requires the basic drone pilot certificate and online exam for drones below 25 kg.

altitudeNote: CAAT guidance states 90 m above ground; temporary restrictions and permissions may be stricter.

insuranceRequired.note: The CAAT guide specifies third-party coverage of at least THB 1,000,000.

importRestriction.note: Import and radio-equipment requirements have not been verified.

notes: Desk research from official sources, not firsthand flight verification. Check current notices and site permissions before a flight.

cityNotes.note: The Grand Palace and much of the centre are restricted; airport approaches cover Suvarnabhumi and Don Mueang.
Beaches near the airport are restricted; national park islands need DNP permission.
Old city temples refuse drones; the airport sits beside the centre.
